cgi_methodology: Transparent Multi-Criteria Weighted Formula: EV/charger (35%), spatial density (25%), per-capita (20%), MoP policy deficit (20%)

ev_to_charger_ratio.influence: Higher ratio indicates charging congestion and queues.

spatial_coverage.influence: Lower chargers per 1,000 km² indicates geographic range-anxiety zones.

per_capita_availability.influence: Lower chargers per 100,000 population indicates public accessibility shortfall.

mop_policy_deficit.influence: Shortfall against MoP 2024 urban municipal guideline minimum.

districts.analytical_disclaimer: The Charging Gap Index (CGI) is an analytical multi-criteria prioritization indicator for planning and investment allocation; it does NOT constitute an official statutory legal finding.
